recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, black-and-white close-up portrait of a male subject with textured hair and a leather jacket, framed by stark geometric sans-serif typography at the top and bottom margins. The lighting creates deep shadows and bright highlights, emphasizing facial structure and material textures.
coreVisualRelationships: Text-to-subject framing where typography acts as horizontal borders
Contrast between smooth skin tones and the coarse texture of leather and hair
Balance between the dark mass of the subject and the bright, blown-out background
coreInvariants: Vertical light-leak or 'spike' effects on specific letterforms

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale head-and-shoulders portrait, slightly off-center, filling the middle 70% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, specifically the one in clearer focus, serving as the central point of engagement.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top text leads to the eyes, down the bridge of the nose to the bottom text, creating a vertical scan.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Bright white space concentrated in the upper corners and behind the subject's head.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks in the hair, jacket, and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for the background and typography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays for skin texture and leather highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value range from 0% to 100% brightness.

letterConstructionRules: Extended vertical terminals on select characters (A, M, T, H) that bleed into the image
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'A' features a crossbar-less or low-crossbar design with a vertical spike extending downwards.
The letter 'M' and 'H' feature vertical extensions that create a needle-like effect.

composition.overlap: Slight overlap of vertical spikes onto the image

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used for both top and bottom text to maintain symmetry.
graphicDevices: Parental advisory style box in bottom left corner

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the clean geometric skeleton required.
Classic geometric proportions suitable for modification.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white portrait of a man with styled dark hair wearing a textured black leather jacket. Use harsh lighting from the side to create deep shadows. The background should be a bright, blown-out white gradient.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply white geometric sans-serif text in all caps at the top and bottom. Use a hairline weight and wide tracking. Extend the vertical strokes of the 'A' and 'H' characters into thin, needle-like spikes that overlap the portrait.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly black and white?
Are the vertical spikes present on the typography?
Is the tracking wide enough to feel airy?
Does the leather jacket show distinct grain and highlight texture?

mustRedesign: Artist name and specific album title text
Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for monolinear stroke consistency in text
Ensure no color artifacts in the grayscale
Verify the 'spike' effect doesn't obscure the eyes
Confirm the leather texture looks realistic and sharp
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast B&W portrait + Hairline Geometric Sans + Vertical stroke extensions = Modern Edgy Editorial Aesthetic
